pages.text: During the decade of peace for the Botanist Flora, rumors spread of $(italics)B-Side/$ versions of generating flowers that would one day come. These were said to challenge what was known about the mechanics of some generating flowers.

These B-Sides were similar to the known "A-Side" mechanics, but with added restrictions or more difficulty in automation. In exchange, more yield would be given in one way or another.$(br2)Only some flowers have been gifted with a B-Side, explained in other entries. The B-Side can be activated by planting on a $(bold)Nylium/$ variant.
